summary: REQUEST_CHANGES on PR #274 exact head 60de91b49338249c1ded74db0d722921ce2fb55d: runtime numeric PolicyInputs values and nowSeconds still reach comparison/arithmetic before primitive number validation, so hostile scalar metamethods can execute across the intended no-execute boundary.
evidence: src/shared/Physics/FidelityManager.luau exact head 60de91b49338249c1ded74db0d722921ce2fb55d keeps isFinite(value: number), validateUnit, validateNonNegative, and validateFiniteNonNegative without a runtime type(value) == 'number' preflight.

validateInputs only rejects a metatable on the top-level PolicyInputs table; a plain top-level record may still contain a metatable-backed scalar such as distanceStuds, significance, networkRelevance, entityRelevance, or secondsSinceInteraction.
Manager:step evaluates isFinite(nowSeconds) before evaluatePolicy, so a hostile non-number timestamp can execute comparison metamethods before rejection and must also be primitive-type-checked first.

The independent adversarial branch PR #278 already records exact failing cases for hostile distanceStuds and hostile nowSeconds, including the required zero-metamethod-execution and retryability contract.
Canonical CI run 31468720518 is green on the exact head, but green CI does not cover this missing adversarial closure; the review is source-only and claims no Studio evidence.

metadata.requiredNextAction: Add primitive-number runtime guards before numeric operations for PolicyInputs scalars and nowSeconds, add/retain adversarial regressions, then rerun exact-head CI/ownership and request fresh independent review.
